relevant_data:
1 compartment: Biota (Biota, Aquatic)

26 biota samples. Species (14): Hippasteria phrygiana, Urasterias lincki, Pteraster pulvillus, Gorgonocephalus arcticus, Pteraster obscurus, Strongylocentrotus pallidus, Gorgonocephalus lamarckii, Ophiopleura borealis, Ophiura sarsii, Pontaster tenuispinus (and 4 more). Tissue types (2): Disc skeleton, Echinoid corona. Life stages: Not reported. Genders: Not reported

3 protocols:
Sampling Protocol - Trawl sampling: (Bottom trawl dragged on the sea bottom for 15 min at depths ranging from 74 to 309 m. Skin and soft body parts were separated from the skeleton, then remaining organic tissue were removed from each skeletal piece under stereomicroscope. No chemical bleaching was used. Skeletal pieces were homogenized using mortar and pestle made of agate.)
Fractionation Protocol - Acid extractable: (For the analysis of other elements, approximately 300 mg of ground and lyophilized samples were weighed and subjected to digestion using the Anton Paar Multiwave GO Microwave Assisted Digestion system. Digestion was carried out using 8 ml of nitric acid.)
Extraction Protocol - Microwave-assisted acid digestion: (For the analysis of other elements, approximately 300 mg of ground and lyophilized samples were weighed and subjected to digestion using the Anton Paar Multiwave GO Microwave Assisted Digestion system. Digestion was carried out using 8 ml of nitric acid.)
limitations: Species and tissue reported in detail. Age and gender not reported.
